description: This file defines API endpoints for managing progress data in a role-based management system. It sets up routes for listing progress items and creating or updating progress entries, utilizing FastAPI's routing, request handling, and response modeling features.

methods.name: get_progress( x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"), assignee: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Assignee identifier for filtering"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of progress entries, filtered by employee role and optionally by assignee.

methods.name: post_progress( payload: ProgressCreate, x_role: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Role"), x_assignee: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Assignee-Identifier"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update a progress entry, with restrictions based on employee role and assignee.
